item.title: After social media ban for teens, France may move to regulate VPNs next
item.description: In France, one of the internet's oldest privacy tools may soon become the focus of a national policy debate. Weeks after lawmakers approved a bill to block social media access for anyone under 15, the French government signaled that virtual private networks could be next on its regulatory agenda.Read Entire Article

item.title: WinRAR 7.20 speeds up archive management, expands command-line flexibility
item.description: WinRAR 7.20 delivers faster handling of large archives, especially when deleting files or opening ZIPs with massive file counts. The update also enhances automation with smarter archive naming masks, expanded command-line switches, and faster extraction for TAR-based formats.Read Entire Article

item.title: AMD reports record 2025 revenues, driven by strong demand for Epyc and Ryzen CPUs
item.description: Q4 revenue grew 34 percent year over year to $10.27 billion, while GAAP profits rose 44 percent to $5.57 billion. Gross margin improved from 51 percent to 54 percent, and operating income increased to $1.75 billion from $871 million. Diluted earnings per share (EPS) reached $0.92, up from $0.29 in Q4 2024.Read Entire Article

item.title: Netflix is ending PlayStation 3 support nearly 20 years after Sony's console launched
item.description: Reddit user golfwang999 revealed the end of the PlayStation 3's Netflix app in a post on the site. The message, which is shown on what looks like an era-appropriate Philips CRT TV, confirms the app's imminent demise and advises users to visit Netflix's list of supported devices.Read Entire Article

item.description: The mission will mark NASA's first crewed test of laser communications in lunar orbit. item.title: Nioh 3 refines Team Ninja's formula into its most ambitious Soulslike yet
item.description: Nioh 3 features deeper, more flexible combat, a semi-open-world structure, and seamless switching between Samurai and Ninja styles, earning praise as the most complete and accessible entry in the series-and one of the stronger modern Soulslike experiences for fans of demanding action RPGs.Read Entire Article

item.title: Plasma engines are emerging as the next frontier in deep-space propulsion
item.description: Plasma propulsion transforms an inert propellant – often hydrogen – into plasma, a superheated mix of ions and electrons. Magnetic fields then funnel and accelerate the plasma to extreme velocities, generating thrust.Read Entire Article
